title: Queue 背压、task_done 与哨兵退出
expected_output:
入队: 40 | 处理: 40
无丢失: True
处理结果完整: True
队列已空且任务已清: True
code:
import queue
import threading


# queue.Queue 自带锁与阻塞语义：有界队列天然提供背压。
# task_done() + join() 是「全部处理完毕」的正确同步方式，
# 用 q.empty() 判断在并发下是错的。

Q = queue.Queue(maxsize=5)
TOTAL = 40
processed = []
retries = 0


def producer():
    for i in range(TOTAL):
        Q.put(i)          # 队列满时阻塞 -> 背压
    for _ in range(3):
        Q.put(None)       # 哨兵：通知 3 个消费者退出


def worker():
    global retries
    while True:
        item = Q.get()
        try:
            if item is None:
                return
            processed.append(item)
        finally:
            Q.task_done()   # 每个 get 后必须调用


producers = [threading.Thread(target=producer)]
workers = [threading.Thread(target=worker) for _ in range(3)]
for t in producers + workers:
    t.start()
Q.join()                  # 等待所有 task_done
for t in producers + workers:
    t.join()

print("入队:", TOTAL, "| 处理:", len(processed))
print("无丢失:", len(processed) == TOTAL)
print("处理结果完整:", sorted(processed) == list(range(TOTAL)))
print("队列已空且任务已清:", Q.empty())
